facts.subject: Ymir Canal Authority
facts.statement: The Ymir Canal Authority is an official outlet that publishes canal notices in a precise, formal style and is rarely wrong.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Ymir Canal Authority is an official outlet that publishes canal notices in a precise, formal style and is rarely wrong.

facts.subject: Realm Trade Ministry
facts.statement: The Realm Trade Ministry is an official outlet for government notices; it is formal and slow, and it may issue later corrections.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Realm Trade Ministry is an official outlet for government notices; it is formal and slow, and it may issue later corrections.

facts.subject: Raven Wire
facts.statement: Raven Wire is a reputable wire service that publishes short, fast reports and openly corrects itself.

source_ref.text_snippet: Raven Wire is a reputable wire service that publishes short, fast reports and openly corrects itself.

facts.subject: Midgard Times
facts.statement: Midgard Times is a reputable business daily that is careful and gives numbers with context.

source_ref.text_snippet: Midgard Times is a reputable business daily that is careful and gives numbers with context.

facts.subject: Harbour Review
facts.statement: Harbour Review and Cargo Weekly are reputable trade publications with detailed shipping, cargo and port coverage.

source_ref.text_snippet: Harbour Review and Cargo Weekly are reputable trade publications with detailed shipping, cargo and port coverage.

facts.subject: Asgard Herald
facts.statement: Asgard Herald is a regional paper with good local detail and some errors.

facts.subject: Tide Research
facts.statement: Tide Research is an analyst firm with opinionated forecasts that are sometimes too sure.

facts.subject: Ledger Analytics
